cohort: The study participants were postnatal women from the inpatient and outpatient departments of gynaecology and obstetrics at Parul Sevashram Hospital.
finding: The prevalence of PPD was 7.14% at the initial visit and decreased to 3.25% one month later, with maternal age, low education level, cesarean delivery, giving birth to a female child, multigravida status, and a history of pregnancy loss identified as risk factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a factor associated with an increased risk for Postpartum Depression.
